name: Novel / unexplained outbreaks
summary: UKHSA's 12 Nov report lists only known pathogens; no unexplained cluster under international investigation found
state: UKHSA's outbreaks-under-monitoring report for the week to 8 Nov, published 12 Nov, covers only known pathogens: Bundibugyo Ebola, H9N2 avian flu in China, Crimean-Congo haemorrhagic fever in Mauritania and Switzerland's first locally acquired chikungunya cases (UKHSA). It identifies no novel pathogen or unexplained cluster. Searches to 14 Nov found none, so the level stays Normal.
for_you: No unexplained outbreak is under international investigation. Travellers can check FCDO travel advice and TravelHealthPro for country-specific health guidance.
rubric_hit: No unexplained clusters under international investigation (UKHSA, week to 8 Nov) = Normal

sources.title: UKHSA — Outbreaks under monitoring: week 45 (week ending 8 November 2026)

why: The next pandemic will start as an unexplained cluster; early signals matter.
drivers: Surveillance reports, unknown illnesses, new pathogens.
